study: Cavalluzzo et al. 2014 — TERC 'Using Data' math PD RCT (Duval County, FL)
delivery_evidence: Primarily face-to-face: in-person group training events, half-day coach/principal workshops, and on-site facilitator visits to each school's data team each year; only 2 of 4 TA sessions were short 1-hour 'at a distance' phone/Skype calls. Note 'The intervention in this study used only the face-to-face program' (vs an available online course). (pp. 9-11, 'Face-to-Face Group Events' / TA-session description)
test_alignment_evidence: Sole extracted student-achievement outcome is the Florida state end-of-grade math assessment (FCAT), a broad independent standardized test not tailored to the data-use PD (test_type standardized_independent). (Table 4.4, p. 54)
curriculum_evidence: PD targets teachers' collaborative data-use practices and data literacy using existing instruction; no new student curriculum/textbook is adopted — only data-team facilitation materials (Data Coach's Kit). (Program Materials section, pp. ~12-13; design summary)
outcome_timing_evidence: Primary confirmatory FCAT impact measured at end of Year 2 (spring 2013), the end of the two-year intervention. (Table 4.4, p. 54; timepoint 'post / end of Year 2')
